test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The advisory board under provisions of Article 22 of the Constitution is to be consisted of persons who are, or have been or are qualified to be appointed as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Judges of High court**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The advisory board under provisions of **Article 22** of the Constitution is to be consisted of persons who are, or have been or are qualified to be appointed as **Judges of High court**.
 
• Article 22 provides for the protection against arrest and detention in certain cases and includes the establishment of advisory boards for reviewing cases of preventive detention.
 
• The advisory board must consist of persons who are or have been judges of a High Court to ensure a fair and just review process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 22** is part of the Fundamental Rights in the Constitution of India, specifically dealing with protection against arbitrary arrest and detention.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
